# Cedar Launch Plan

This document is fictional demonstration data, not a real product commitment.

## Preview scope

The Cedar limited preview starts on 16 November 2026 and is capped at 200 projects.
Preview enrollment is invite-only. The project cap is an enrollment limit, not an availability promise.

## Release gates

Preview release requires a completed restore drill, valid source citations, and a passed permission-revocation test.
The release owner is the Product Lead; the restore drill is owned by the Operations Lead.

## General availability

No general-availability date has been approved.
